backchannels.direction: Так, ага, угу show listening; зразумела (akanye spelling, not понятно) agrees; так-так-так can sound hurried.

reactions.direction: Сапраўды? (with ў) or Ды ну! for surprise; шкада for regret, as in Ukrainian; віншую for good news.

cant_hear.direction: Say you hear badly (дрэнна чую — дрэнна, not плохо/погано) or the line is weak (сувязь кепская); ask for гучней.

ask_repeat.direction: Перапрашаю? or Прабачце? asks for a replay; ask names па літарах; echo the нумар.

who_is_calling.direction: Хто гаворыць? or З кім я размаўляю? with вы; note тэлефануе (цеканне: т→ц before soft vowels).

examples.text: З кім я размаўляю, калі ласка?

wrong_number.direction: Say вы памыліліся нумарам and nobody by that name is here; brief.

examples.text: Тут няма нікога з такім імем.

relay.direction: Перадам (same root as Russian) tells the caller {owner} will hear of it; name no time for a reply.

sales_decline.direction: Дзякуй (дз where Russian has спасибо), мне не цікава is the plain polite no.

firm_no.direction: On a second push, cite the earlier refusal and ask them to stop dialling; калі ласка, not пожалуйста.

examples.text: Калі ласка, больш не тэлефануйце на гэты нумар.
Выдаліце гэты нумар са свайго спісу.

address_forms.direction: Вы for strangers; спадар/спадарыня (not господин/пан) or first name + patronymic; ты only when invited.

avoid_service_phrases.direction: Lines like Ваш званок вельмі важны для нас sound like a кол-цэнтр recording.

examples.text: Ваш званок вельмі важны для нас.
Дзякуем, што патэлефанавалі ў службу падтрымкі.

taboo_on_phone.direction: Ты with older strangers, asking pay or marriage, or remarking on the caller's choice of language is rude.

uncertain: Per the 2019 census (Wikipedia, Languages of Belarus) about 71% speak Russian at home and about 26% Belarusian; many callers will open in Russian or trasianka, and the AI should follow the caller's language
Trasianka (Belarusian-Russian mixed speech) is common in everyday talk but has no fixed norm, so it is not modelled here; examples use standard Belarusian
Two spellings coexist (official narkamaŭka vs. taraškievica); examples use the official one
No Belarusian phone-call corpus found; backchannels and phrasing come from dictionaries and grammar descriptions
